label: B25-RX-OBSERVABILITY-VOLATILE-SOF
title: Generate one volatile SOF from the accepted RX observability fitted database
scope: Create a never-before-used byte-identical clone of the accepted T-007 remote physical project, verify source and fitted database identities, run only Quartus assembler once, and seal the single volatile catapult_a10.sof with size/hash/checksum.
